sources.entry: Mafl - Minimalistic flexible homepage. (Source Code) MIT Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Mafl is a minimalistic, configurable self-hosted homepage that organizes links to your services into grouped, interactive cards.
summary.what_it_does: Mafl is a personal homepage/dashboard configured through a YAML file (config.yml). You define service groups and services, and each service can show interactive cards with extra information such as IP address details or local weather. Third-party requests are made from the backend rather than the browser. It supports multiple languages (set by auto-detection or the lang property), several themes, tags on services, and icons from Iconify, emoji, image URLs, or local files. The app is installable as a PWA. It can be run via a Docker image, from a Node/yarn build, or inside a Proxmox VE LXC created with a provided script.
use_cases: self-hosted start page for home services
homepage with links grouped by category
dashboard showing IP address and weather
installable PWA launcher for self-hosted apps
how_to_run: Docker: create a docker-compose.yml using image hywax/mafl, map port 3000:3000, and mount ./mafl/ to /app/data/
Proxmox: run the provided bash script in the Proxmox VE shell, then edit /opt/mafl/data/config.yml
notable: Backend handles all third-party requests, keeping them out of the browser
Iconify support with over 200,000 vector icons, plus emoji, URL, and local icon types
Built-in IP API and weather service cards
caveats: Configuration is done by hand-editing config.yml, with no GUI described in the README
The README does not describe any authentication or access control features
keywords: start page for my home server
